text: Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: Retain P3 optional viewer capability. Current SurfaceViewSlot has viewport/world translations only; SurfaceViewerState and SurfaceRenderPlan retain one camera. Local a3ee73b exists on surface/paired-responsive-20260910 and is not contained by main, so the body claim of no implementation is superseded by the recovery branch and consumer notes. Reconcile this candidate with adopted renderer work rather than independently reimplementing. Preserve asymmetric hemisphere/original-ID pick proof, backward scene compatibility or explicit typed refusal, and consistent per-slot render/pick cameras. Physical device scale, partial clipping, WebGL, latency and paired-lighting appearance remain separately qualified gates, not implied by the consumer backport tests.
